rules: System IDs are stable and unique; do not reuse retired IDs.
Every system must have exactly one accountable human owner role.
AI maintainer and independent AI auditor responsibilities must be separated for each change.
Owned paths must be explicit; overlapping ownership requires a documented shared-boundary rule.
Dependencies must reference registered system IDs and must not contain cycles without an explicit exception.
Status and version changes require a reviewed GitHub change.
A proposed system is not considered implemented or runtime-active merely because it is registered.
Registry files describe desired state; D1 may store operational snapshots but must not silently redefine registry policy.
